title: Price-regime clustering (k-means) as a feature for the next day's mean price
why: Unsupervised structure (clusters of daily shapes) is a standard source of features and of operational monitoring in energy forecasting.
notes: k = 2 chosen by silhouette on 2019-01-01 to 2025-10-31 (silhouette by k: {2: 0.3079, 3: 0.2299, 4: 0.2313, 5: 0.2294, 6: 0.1988}); share of training days per regime in percent: [np.float64(48.8), np.float64(51.2)].
Pinball loss averaged over the 10%, 50% and 90% quantiles of the next day's mean price, test year 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31; the regime is that of the last known day.
limits: One market, one year of test days; the interval is a day-block bootstrap.
Backtest-only: nothing changes in the live `ml` forecaster.
